findings.summary: The pack digest wraps numbers as {"$number": repr}, an encoding neither ADR 0006 nor ADR 0032 defines, still labelled jcs-sha256-v1.
The number transform is not injective: {"n": 1} and {"n": {"$number": "1"}} digest alike; NaN/inf collide with null; repr is Python-specific.
The default budgets are recorded only in the SDD report.
layer_budgets is not checked to cover every ContextLayer; an error message reads as a statement.
_check_layers duplicates the validator; build() constructs twice; the Dropped.ref docstring omits the ADR §5 ref forms.
